# IDGen

> IDGen — Identity Solutions, Simplified. IDGen manufactures ID cards, RFID credentials, custom lanyards, acrylic badges, and zinc medals for schools, colleges, universities, and enterprises across Northeast India.

IDGen prints ID cards on durable 30-mil PVC with edge-to-edge lamination, embeds RFID chips for access-control and library systems, and produces custom-branded lanyards, acrylic badges, and die-cast zinc medals. Bulk orders are manufactured in-house in Guwahati, Assam and dispatched across Assam and Meghalaya (Shillong) with 48–72h turnaround; coverage in other Northeast Indian states is expanding.
